mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,user_id,domain,top_level_agent_id,session_id,session_kind,original_object_type,original_object_id FROM ai_memory_session_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND user_id=#{user} AND session_id=#{session} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,id,subject_type,subject_id,owner_id,domain,origin_top_agent_id,scope_type,scope_id,purpose,field_key,lifecycle,revision,current_version_id,grant_epoch,source_epoch,deletion_epoch FROM ai_memory_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_item SET current_version_id=#{currentVersion,jdbcType=VARBINARY},lifecycle=#{lifecycle},revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT target_type,target_id,target_version,execution_id,root_thread_ref,child_thread_ref,checkpoint_namespace FROM ai_memory_dependency WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_id=#{source}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_memory_tombstone(tenant_id,target_type,target_id,deletion_epoch,grant_epoch,source_epoch) VALUES (#{tenant},#{type},#{target},#{deletionEpoch},#{grantEpoch},#{sourceEpoch}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deletion_epoch=GREATEST(deletion_epoch,VALUES(deletion_epoch)),grant_epoch=GREATEST(grant_epoch,VALUES(grant_epoch)),source_epoch=GREATEST(source_epoch,VALUES(source_epoch))
mapper.sql: tenant_id=#{tenant} AND subject_type='USER' AND subject_id=#{user} AND owner_id=#{user} AND domain=#{domain} AND origin_top_agent_id=#{domain} AND scope_type='USER_PRIVATE' AND purpose='assistant_response'
mapper.select: SELECT p.id,v.version_id,v.policy_json,v.content_hmac,v.schema_version FROM ai_memory_policy p JOIN ai_memory_policy_version v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.policy_id=p.id AND v.version_id=p.current_version_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.domain=#{domain} AND p.enabled=TRUE ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 2
SELECT FROM ai_memory_item WHERE AND field_key=#{field}
SELECT policy_id AS id,version_id,policy_json,content_hmac,schema_version FROM ai_memory_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND policy_id=#{policy} AND version_id=#{version}

SELECT v.item_id,v.id AS version_id,v.policy_id,v.policy_version_id,p.policy_json,p.schema_version FROM ai_memory_version v JOIN ai_memory_policy_version p ON p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND p.policy_id=v.policy_id AND p.version_id=v.policy_version_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND
(v.item_id,v.id) IN (#{entry.itemId},#{entry.versionId}) 1=0
SELECT FROM ai_memory_item WHERE AND lifecycle='LIVE' AND current_version_id IS NOT NULL AND field_key IN ('response.language','response.detail_level','response.format') ORDER BY field_key
mapper.sql: (i.lifecycle<>'LIVE' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_tombstone t WHERE t.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND t.target_type='MEMORY_ITEM' AND t.target_id=i.id AND (i.grant_epoch<=t.grant_epoch OR i.source_epoch<t.source_epoch OR i.deletion_epoch<t.deletion_epoch)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_suppression sup WHERE sup.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND sup.subject_type=i.subject_type AND sup.subject_id=i.subject_id AND sup.domain=i.domain AND sup.scope_type=i.scope_type AND sup.scope_id=i.scope_id AND sup.purpose=i.purpose AND sup.field_key=i.field_key AND sup.suppression_kind='FIELD' AND sup.active=TRUE))

(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_tombstone t WHERE t.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND t.target_type='SOURCE' AND t.target_id=s.id AND (s.grant_epoch<=t.grant_epoch OR s.source_epoch<t.source_epoch OR s.deletion_epoch<t.deletion_epoch)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_suppression sup WHERE sup.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND sup.source_id=s.id AND sup.source_version=s.source_version AND sup.suppression_kind='SOURCE' AND sup.active=TRUE) OR (s.source_type='USER_PREFERENCE_DECISION' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_decision owner_decision JOIN ai_memory_version owner_version ON owner_version.tenant_id=owner_decision.tenant_id AND owner_version.item_id=owner_decision.item_id AND owner_version.id=owner_decision.target_version_id AND owner_version.decision_id=owner_decision.id JOIN ai_memory_item i ON i.tenant_id=owner_version.tenant_id AND i.id=owner_version.item_id WHERE owner_decision.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND owner_decision.id=s.source_object_ref AND owner_decision.actor_kind='USER' AND owner_decision.actor_id=i.owner_id AND owner_version.id=s.source_version AND owner_version.status IN ('ACTIVE','SUPERSEDED') AND owner_version.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND owner_version.grant_epoch=i.grant_epoch AND owner_version.source_epoch=i.source_epoch AND owner_version.deletion_epoch=i.deletion_epoch AND NOT )))

AND NOT AND v.grant_epoch=i.grant_epoch AND v.source_epoch=i.source_epoch AND v.deletion_epoch=i.deletion_epoch AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_dependency dep JOIN ai_memory_source user_source ON user_source.tenant_id=dep.tenant_id AND user_source.id=dep.source_id WHERE dep.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND dep.target_type='MEMORY_VERSION' AND dep.target_id=v.item_id AND dep.target_version=v.id AND user_source.source_type='USER_PREFERENCE_DECISION' AND user_source.source_object_ref=v.decision_id AND user_source.source_version=v.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_dependency dep LEFT JOIN ai_memory_source s ON s.tenant_id=dep.tenant_id AND s.id=dep.source_id WHERE dep.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND dep.target_type='MEMORY_VERSION' AND dep.target_id=v.item_id AND dep.target_version=v.id AND (s.id IS NULL OR (s.source_type='USER_PREFERENCE_DECISION' AND s.source_object_ref=v.decision_id AND s.source_version<>v.id) OR s.source_type NOT IN ('USER_PREFERENCE_DECISION','MESSAGE','CURRENT_USER_MESSAGE') OR (s.source_type='USER_PREFERENCE_DECISION' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_decision source_decision JOIN ai_memory_item source_item ON source_item.tenant_id=source_decision.tenant_id AND source_item.id=source_decision.item_id WHERE source_decision.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND source_decision.id=s.source_object_ref AND source_decision.actor_kind='USER' AND source_decision.actor_id=i.owner_id AND source_item.owner_id=i.owner_id AND source_item.subject_id=i.subject_id AND source_item.domain=i.domain AND source_item.origin_top_agent_id=i.origin_top_agent_id)) OR (s.source_type IN ('MESSAGE','CURRENT_USER_MESSAGE') AND NOT( (i.domain='operations' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_operation_message msg JOIN ai_operation_conversation conversation ON conversation.id=msg.conversation_id WHERE CAST(msg.tenant_id AS BINARY)=s.tenant_id AND CAST(conversation.tenant_id AS BINARY)=s.tenant_id AND CAST(conversation.user_id AS BINARY)=i.owner_id AND CAST(msg.id AS BINARY)=s.source_object_ref AND CAST(SHA2(CAST(msg.content AS BINARY),256) AS BINARY)=s.source_version)) OR (i.domain='customer-service' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_customer_service_message msg JOIN ai_customer_service_conversation conversation ON conversation.id=msg.conversation_id WHERE CAST(msg.tenant_id AS BINARY)=s.tenant_id AND CAST(conversation.tenant_id AS BINARY)=s.tenant_id AND CAST(conversation.user_id AS BINARY)=i.owner_id AND CAST(msg.id AS BINARY)=s.source_object_ref AND CAST(SHA2(CAST(msg.content_markdown AS BINARY),256) AS BINARY)=s.source_version)))) OR s.retention_deadline IS NULL OR s.retention_deadline<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) OR s.grant_epoch<>dep.grant_epoch OR s.source_epoch<>dep.source_epoch OR s.deletion_epoch<>dep.deletion_epoch OR ))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_version v JOIN ai_memory_decision d ON d.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND d.id=v.decision_id JOIN ai_memory_item i ON i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.id=v.item_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND v.item_id=#{item} ORDER BY d.resulting_revision DESC
SELECT tenant_id,id,item_id,target_version_id,actor_id,decision_type,request_id,expected_revision,resulting_revision FROM ai_memory_decision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{request}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_item SET current_version_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{item} AND revision=#{revision} AND current_version_id=#{version} AND lifecycle='LIVE'
UPDATE ai_memory_version SET status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} AND id=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_memory_suppression WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND subject_type='USER' AND subject_id=#{user} AND domain=#{domain} AND scope_type='USER_PRIVATE' AND scope_id=#{scope} AND purpose='assistant_response' AND field_key=#{field} AND suppression_kind='FIELD' AND active=TRUE
